start.title: One Last Word
start.text:
The Lord speaks at dusk in Goshen.
A final sign will free His people.

choices.feedback: His word is not yours to weigh.
You bow your head and listen.

choices.text: Hide His word from the people
choices.feedback: It must be told to all.

argue_consequence.title: Do Not Argue
argue_consequence.text:
He has set the hour Himself.
Receive what He commands.

hide_consequence.title: Speak It to All
hide_consequence.text:
His word is for every household.
Do not keep it to yourself.

gather_elders.title: Aaron at Your Side
gather_elders.text:
Aaron waits, the elders behind him.
What must each household do?

any_animal_consequence.title: Without Blemish
any_animal_consequence.text:
Not any beast. The Lord chose this.
Obey His word exactly.

lamb_chosen.title: On the Fourteenth Day
lamb_chosen.text:
The lamb is kept until twilight.
Then all Israel slays it together.

choices.text: Pour the blood on the ground

hide_blood_consequence.title: Show the Sign
hide_blood_consequence.text:
It is the sign He looks for.
Do not hide what He commanded.

ground_consequence.title: On the Doorframe
ground_consequence.text:
Lintel and side posts, He said.
That is where the sign must rest.

doorposts_marked.title: The Sign on Every Door
doorposts_marked.text:
Red marks the wood of every home.
Now the meal must be prepared.

choices.text: Roast the lamb with bitter herbs

boil_consequence.title: As He Commanded
boil_consequence.text:
Roasted by fire. No leaven tonight.
Do it the way He spoke.

choices.text: Roast the lamb with bitter herbs

meal_prepared.title: Eat in Haste
meal_prepared.text:
Loins girded. Sandals on. Staff in hand.
Ready to leave at His word.

choices.text: Sit at ease, take your time

choices.feedback: The door is shut behind you.

ease_consequence.title: Be Ready
ease_consequence.text:
Tonight you eat as travelers.
Ready to rise and go.

wander_consequence.title: Stay Within
wander_consequence.text:
The blood guards only those inside.
Do not step beyond the door.

stay_inside.title: Midnight
stay_inside.text:
A great cry rises from Egypt.
In Goshen, only silence.

choices.text: Open the door to look out

choices.feedback: It is His mercy, not yours.
The lamps burn low and warm.

open_consequence.title: Wait on Him
open_consequence.text:
The Lord passes over tonight.
Do not break the watch.

boast_consequence.title: His Mercy, Not Yours
boast_consequence.text:
It is the blood that spares you.
Not your hand, not your name.

morning_summons.title: Pharaoh's Messengers
morning_summons.text:
Before dawn they pound your door.
The king himself summons you now.

choices.feedback: You walk into the still city.

refuse_consequence.title: The Hour Has Come
refuse_consequence.text:
He calls. Do not turn aside.
This is the moment promised.

choices.feedback: You take the road to the palace.

before_broken_pharaoh.title: "Go. Serve the Lord."
before_broken_pharaoh.text:
Pharaoh stands hollow with grief.
"Take your flocks. Leave my land."

choices.feedback: Do not strike a broken man.

choices.text: Accept and call the people forth

mock_consequence.title: Not Mockery
mock_consequence.text:
Judgment was His to give.
Receive his word and go.

choices.text: Accept and call the people forth

half_consequence.title: All, With All
half_consequence.text:
Not one child. Not one beast.
All the people go free.

choices.text: Accept and call the people forth

ending.title: Toward the Sunrise
ending.text:
Israel rises from Goshen at dawn.
The long night is finished.
